nodes.label: API-Routes.md
nodes.rationale: Complete API contract documentation with all endpoints, authentication, WebSocket events, error codes, and pagination standards

nodes.label: ADR 001 - Prisma Schema Unificado
nodes.rationale: Decision to unify two Prisma schemas into packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma as single source of truth

nodes.label: ADR 002 - Docker Compose Local
nodes.rationale: Decision to use docker-compose.prod.yml as only deployment method with 5 orchestrated services

nodes.label: ADR 003 - Evolution API Integration
nodes.rationale: Decision to integrate with self-hosted Evolution API for WhatsApp messaging via webhooks and HTTP API

nodes.label: ZapTI Project
nodes.rationale: Multi-tenant WhatsApp helpdesk platform monorepo

nodes.label: Monorepo Structure
nodes.rationale: Four workspace structure: apps/api, apps/web, packages/shared, packages/database

nodes.label: apps/api (Fastify API)
nodes.rationale: Fastify + Prisma + TypeScript API server on port 3000 with plugins, routes, services, JWT auth, multi-tenant

nodes.label: apps/web (Next.js Web)
nodes.rationale: Next.js 14 + React 18 + Tailwind frontend on port 3001 with Radix UI, TanStack Query, Zustand

nodes.label: packages/shared
nodes.rationale: ESM shared package with config, auth, email, notification, utils, constants, validation, types exports

nodes.label: packages/database
nodes.rationale: Prisma schema & migrations package - single source of truth for data model

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Service
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL 16 database on port 5432 with schemas public (api) and evolution (evolution-api)

nodes.label: Redis Service
nodes.rationale: Redis 7 on port 6379 for caching, queues, and Evolution API session storage

nodes.label: Evolution API Service
nodes.rationale: Evolution API (evoapicloud/evolution-api:latest) on port 8080 for WhatsApp Business API wrapper with webhooks

nodes.label: API Service (Docker)
nodes.rationale: API container built from apps/api/Dockerfile on port 3000 with env vars for DB, Redis, JWT, Evolution

nodes.label: Web Service (Docker)
nodes.rationale: Web container built from apps/web/Dockerfile on port 3001 with NEXT_PUBLIC_* env vars

nodes.label: Auth Module (/auth)
nodes.rationale: JWT authentication endpoints: login, refresh, logout, me, 2FA enable/verify/disable

nodes.label: Tenants Module (/tenants)
nodes.rationale: SUPER_ADMIN only tenant CRUD and stats endpoints

nodes.label: Users Module (/users)
nodes.rationale: ADMIN+ user management: list, create, update, delete, invite, password reset

nodes.label: Contacts Module (/contacts)
nodes.rationale: Contact CRUD with tags, groups, import, and conversation linking

nodes.label: Conversations Module (/conversations)
nodes.rationale: Conversation management with status, priority, assignment, messaging, read receipts

nodes.label: Messages Module (/messages)
nodes.rationale: Message listing and sending with conversation/contact filtering

nodes.label: Tickets Module (/tickets)
nodes.rationale: Helpdesk ticket CRUD with comments, assignment, status changes

nodes.label: Groups Module (/groups)
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp group management with members

nodes.label: Campaigns Module (/campaigns)
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp campaign broadcasting with scheduling, logs, send/cancel

nodes.label: Automations Module (/automations)
nodes.rationale: Automation engine with triggers, conditions, actions, execution history

nodes.label: Webhooks Module (/webhooks)
nodes.rationale: Evolution API webhook receiver with apikey auth for MESSAGES_UPSERT, CONNECTION_UPDATE, QRCODE_UPDATED

nodes.label: Integrations Module (/integrations)
nodes.rationale: External integration management with config, testing, CRUD

nodes.label: Settings Module (/settings)
nodes.rationale: Tenant-scoped key-value settings CRUD

nodes.label: Templates Module (/templates)
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp Business API template management with Meta submission

nodes.label: Audit Module (/audit)
nodes.rationale: ADMIN+ audit log querying with filters

nodes.label: Health Module (/health, /ready)
nodes.rationale: Liveness and readiness checks with dependency verification

nodes.label: WebSocket Events
nodes.rationale: Real-time events: new:message, update:conversation, new:ticket, update:ticket, notification with subscribe/unsubscribe

nodes.label: Prisma Schema (packages/database)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for data models: Tenant, User, Contact, Conversation, Message, Ticket, Group, Campaign, Automation, Webhook, Integration, AuditLog, Setting, Template, RefreshToken, PasswordReset, CampaignLog, AutomationExecution

nodes.label: UserRole Enum
nodes.rationale: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, AGENT, VIEWER roles for authorization

nodes.label: ConversationStatus Enum
nodes.rationale: OPEN, PENDING, RESOLVED, CLOSED, SPAM conversation states

nodes.label: MessageType Enum
nodes.rationale: TEXT, IMAGE, AUDIO, VIDEO, DOCUMENT, LOCATION, CONTACT, STICKER, REACTION, TEMPLATE message types

nodes.label: MessageDirection Enum
nodes.rationale: INBOUND, OUTBOUND message directions

nodes.label: TicketStatus Enum
nodes.rationale: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING, RESOLVED, CLOSED ticket states

nodes.label: AutomationTrigger Enum
nodes.rationale: NEW_MESSAGE, NEW_CONVERSATION, KEYWORD_MATCH, TIME_BASED, CONTACT_TAG_ADDED, TICKET_CREATED, TICKET_STATUS_CHANGED triggers

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.rationale: Access token 15min, refresh token 7d with tenantId in payload for multi-tenancy

nodes.label: Fastify Middleware Chain
nodes.rationale: helmet -> cors -> rateLimit -> jwt.verify -> tenantPlugin -> route handler

nodes.label: Inbound Message Flow
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp -> Evolution -> Webhook -> API -> Contact/Conversation/Message -> Automation -> WebSocket

nodes.label: Outbound Message Flow
nodes.rationale: Agent -> API -> Evolution -> WhatsApp -> Webhook status update -> Message status DELIVERED/READ

nodes.label: Automation Engine
nodes.rationale: Trigger -> Conditions -> Actions pattern with JSON conditions and action types: SEND_MESSAGE, ASSIGN_AGENT, CREATE_TICKET, ADD_TAG, WEBHOOK

nodes.label: Evolution Webhook Processing
nodes.rationale: processEvolutionWebhook() handles MESSAGES_UPSERT, CONNECTION_UPDATE, QRCODE_UPDATED events

nodes.label: Critical Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, JWT_SECRET, EVOLUTION_API_URL, EVOLUTION_API_KEY, EVOLUTION_INSTANCE_NAME, CORS_ORIGIN, NEXT_PUBLIC_*

nodes.label: Health Checks
nodes.rationale: Service health endpoints: pg_isready, redis-cli ping, wget evolution, wget api/health

nodes.label: Prisma Performance Indexes
nodes.rationale: Composite indexes for Conversation, Message, Ticket, AuditLog queries

nodes.label: Security Measures
nodes.rationale: Helmet, CORS, Rate Limit, JWT RS256/HS256, bcrypt cost 12, 2FA TOTP, Audit Log, Tenant Isolation

nodes.label: Observability
nodes.rationale: Pino logs, /health (liveness), /ready (readiness), Swagger /docs, AuditLog table

nodes.label: Vault Structure (PARA)
nodes.rationale: Índice.md, Visao-Geral.md, Arquitetura.md, Tarefas.md, Problemas-e-Solucoes.md, Decisoes/ ADRs

nodes.label: Vault Conventions
nodes.rationale: Naming, linking (Wikilinks), frontmatter, maintenance checklist, anti-patterns

nodes.label: Handoff Protocol
nodes.rationale: Mandatory handoff.md update after each request with estado atual, arquivos alterados, problemas, proximos passos

nodes.label: Development Commands
nodes.rationale: npm run dev/build/lint/typecheck/test/db:* for root, api, web, shared, database workspaces

nodes.label: Known Issues/Risks
nodes.rationale: Two Prisma schemas, CampaignLog relation, missing sendErrorNotification, TS errors, Docker build, Evolution unverified, no GitHub remote

nodes.label: Recommended Workflow
nodes.rationale: Git status -> Unify Prisma -> Compile order (shared->database->api->web) -> Docker build/up -> Test Evolution -> Push GitHub
